purpose: Documents the model currently used by the RK3568 service; the RKNN binary is kept in the existing Ubuntu and board package.

target.toolkit_version_note: Original model conversion environment is unavailable; 2.3.2 is the documented board runtime version, not verified conversion provenance.

labels.order: COCO class id, one label per line, zero based

preprocess.quantization: RKNN runtime converts UINT8 input using model tensor attributes

outputs.quantized_tensor_attributes: Read dtype, qnt_type, zero_point and scale from RKNN_QUERY_OUTPUT_ATTR; do not hardcode scale or zero_point.

quantization.calibration_rule: Use RGB565-derived deployment images covering daylight, shadow, night, signal lights and lane markings.
quantization.accuracy_gate: Compare PyTorch, ONNX, RKNN desktop and RK3568 outputs on the same frame set before replacement.

semantic_bindings.traffic_light_state: Not encoded by this detector; traffic_light.py uses color evidence.
semantic_bindings.lane_geometry: Not encoded by this detector; lane_detection.py uses image geometry.

compatibility.c_decoder: pcie_rknn_probe.c expects class_count=80, three YOLOv5 heads and the anchors above.
compatibility.python_decoder: rknn_stream.py and draw_detections.py expect COCO labels in this order.
compatibility.change_rule: Any class count, head layout, anchor, input, preprocessing or quantization change requires a new manifest and decoder review.

implementation_hash_rule: sha256 of UTF-8 text with CRLF normalized to LF
